Name: Consistent Tree Growth Speed
Author: asrdfsdvs
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size][size=2]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 2.6+.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Change the growth speed in the config file located in Stardew Valley/Mods/ConsistentTreeGrowthSpeed/config.json. 
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/size]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]daysToGrow: The amount of days the non-fruit trees will take to grow (default: 14 days).
[*]treesGrowOnWinter: Defines if trees grow on winter (default: false).
[/list]
[size=5]Extra info[/size][list]
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/ConsistentTreeGrowthSpeed.
[/list]
[size=5]Changelog[/size]
[list]
[*]1.0 - Release;
[*]1.0.1 - Now trees don't grow on winter (unless specified on the config);
[*]1.1.0 - Updated to SMAPI 2.7;
[/list]

Manifest.Name: ConsistentTreeGrowthSpeed
Manifest.Description: Changes the trees growth speed based on the config.
Manifest.Author: IceGladiador
